task: pothole detection (1 class) - fine-tuned, measured on the held-out test split

dataset.source: Ryukijano/Pothole-detection-Yolov8 on Hugging Face (Roboflow "Potholes" export; train+valid pooled and re-split 85/15 by unique source photo) + RDD2020 India subset (Arya et al. 2020, real Indian road photos, D40/pothole only; split 70/15/15, test slice added to the Ryukijano test, never subtracted)

baseline_note: The COCO model used in the AI path has no pothole class, so before fine-tuning it cannot report potholes at all.

cpu_speed_laptop.note: onnxruntime on the development laptop, NOT a Pi 5
